title: Deadrot canonical asset index
description: Generated index of every shipped media asset in packages/assets: stable id, kind, owning game, local + CDN address, media type, byte size, content hash, and intrinsic dimensions. Produced by scripts/generate-asset-index.mjs (deadrot.com#343); regenerate with `bun run --cwd packages/assets assets:index`.

version.description: Format version of the index document.

cdnBase.description: Default CDN origin; overridable at runtime via ASSET_BASE_URL or an explicit baseUrl.

assets.description: Every shipped media asset, sorted by package-relative path.

id.description: Stable id: POSIX package-relative path without the media extension.

kind.description: Semantic family. webm/mp4 under an audio/ tree resolve to 'audio'.

game.description: Owning game slug (the games/<slug>/ directory), or null for non-game roots (shared, brand, universe, entities, concepts, tokens).

path.description: Package-relative path (with extension), for dev/build tooling.

cdnPath.description: CDN-relative path, joined onto a base origin for deployed runtime.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the file contents.

width.description: Intrinsic width in px, where available.

height.description: Intrinsic height in px, where available.
